texts.value: Catalyzes the ATP-dependent synthesis of L-asparagine from L-aspartate, using L-glutamine as a source of nitrogen (PubMed:2564390, PubMed:2573597). Can also use ammonia as the nitrogen source in vitro (PubMed:2564390, PubMed:2573597)

reaction.name: L-aspartate + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = L-asparagine + L-glutamate + AMP + diphosphate + H(+)
L-aspartate + NH4(+) + ATP = L-asparagine + AMP + diphosphate + H(+)

texts.value: kcat is 0.83 sec(-1) for the reaction with glutamine as nitrogen source (at pH 8.0 and 37 degrees Celsius) (PubMed:39627226). kcat is 0.59 sec(-1) for the reaction with ammonia as nitrogen source (at pH 8.0 and 37 degrees Celsius) (PubMed:39627226).
Amino-acid biosynthesis; L-asparagine biosynthesis; L-asparagine from L-aspartate (L-Gln route): step 1/1

disease.description: An inborn error of asparagine biosynthesis that results in a severe neurologic disorder characterized by microcephaly, severely delayed psychomotor development, progressive encephalopathy, cortical atrophy, and seizure or hyperekplexic activity.

texts.value: The disease is caused by variants affecting the gene represented in this entry
